title: Explore Identity and Access Management
summary: Identity security courseware with AI-assisted interactions for Okta Learning.
body: Customer education for Okta Learning and Customer Advancement: identity and access management courseware authored in Parta with AI-generated interactions, custom illustration, and production workflows aligned to brand. The sample below is representative of modules shipping on the public learning platform; the full catalog lives on Okta Learning.

title: Mitigate Threats Using ThreatInsight
body: Customer-facing ThreatInsight training for Okta Learning: scenario-based instruction, product visuals, and knowledge checks aligned to Customer Advancement standards and the Ascentia design system.

title: Various projects
client: American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine (ACVIM)
summary: eLearning, video, LMS transition, and on-demand builds for a national certifying body.
body: Long-term engagement with ACVIM, the national certifying organization for veterinary specialists: eLearning development, annual Forum recordings, LMS transition and administration, Caveon and Cadmium assessment workflows, and on-demand builds for members and certifying programs.

title: SuperSpeed Certified
summary: Three-level PGA-accredited credential for golf coaches worldwide.
body: Three-level PGA-accredited certification program for golf coaches: video production, Storyline interactions, quizzes, and capstone assessment delivered on a virtual platform. Built for coaches who needed structured progression without in-person-only access.

title: The Performance Company
body: Soft-skills curriculum based on Catherine Mattiske's frameworks: immersive modules, assessments, job aids, animated video, learning journals, and activity booklets. Managed global delivery quality and template standards across 550+ products.

title: Piano tuning & moving
summary: Online certificate program from SME storyboards and raw video.
body: End-to-end development of interactive certificate courses from SME storyboards and raw footage: Storyline authoring, media production in Adobe Creative Suite, and deployment on LearnUpon. Program supports the Piano Technicians Guild endorsement track for piano tuning and moving.

title: ECG interpretations
summary: Interactive guide to heart rhythms on ECGs for domestic animals.
body: Responsive learning aid for heart rhythms on domestic-animal ECGs. Hotspots, narration, and video let clinicians rehearse pattern recognition without waiting on live caseload. Constructivist interactions mirror the clinical task: identify the rhythm, confirm the finding, move on.

title: Contemporary leadership
summary: Self-paced WBT converted from live virtual training.
body: Converted synchronous virtual training into self-paced WBT for Australian primary-school educators. External readings, video, and Storyline interactives replaced live sessions while keeping the facilitated feel of the original program.

title: SECURE Fixed Term Annuity IV
summary: Modernized compliance eLearning for annual training.
body: Modernized compliance eLearning for annual agent training: Captivate interactions, media, and knowledge checks replacing legacy slide decks. Built for repeat yearly completion without learner fatigue.

title: Job specializations
body: Industry knowledge courses for recruiters and business development staff. Rise modules with media, interactions, and a searchable glossary so staffing teams could speak credibly to clients in specialized verticals.

title: City Targeting in HasOffers
summary: Instructional video from a 40+ video series.
body: One module in a series of 40+ instructional videos for the HasOffers ad platform. Produced in After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Audition with tight scripting for a technical SMB audience.

title: Rise for Dummies
body: Quick-turn Rise 360 demonstration covering block types, navigation, and responsive layout. Built as a reusable reference for stakeholders evaluating Rise against Storyline for short-form product training.
